purpose: Future stats implementation research. These files are not imported into the live app.

fieldRules.baseStats: Combat values with level, class, route and chapter context. Never treat an observed recruited unit as normalized level 1.
fieldRules.growthRatesPercent: Personal growth percentages, separate from base combat values.
fieldRules.growthModifiersPercentagePoints: Class or mount growth adjustments, not immediate combat-stat gains.
fieldRules.preferredSkills: Faster-training strengths; never infer a starting rank from these.
fieldRules.startingRanks: Exact observed initial proficiency. Unknown is null, never an assumed E rank.
fieldRules.currentRanks: User-entered progress, separate from external reference data.
fieldRules.targetRanks: Chosen plan requirements, separate from starting and current ranks. Preserve required versus alternative skill logic.
fieldRules.unknowns: Null means not established. Keep source claims separate instead of silently resolving disagreement.
fieldRules.verification: Page checked means the publisher states it; not independently verified in-game. Agreement between aggregators is not necessarily independent evidence.

sources.name: EODdb
